0676327436091.sourceDescription:
Bring a warm festive glow to your home, porch or garden with this 6ft Snowy LED Twig Tree. Its brown twig branches have a snow-effect finish and are lit by 300 warm white LEDs. The slim profile and square base make it a decorative feature for entrances, living rooms and patios.

Choose from eight lighting sequences, from a steady glow to a twinkling effect. The built-in memory function recalls your last selected setting, and the timer repeats a daily cycle of 6 hours on and 18 hours off. The approximately 5m mains lead gives you flexibility when positioning the tree.

Key features

Approx. 1.8m tall (6ft) with snow-effect twig branches and a square base.

300 warm white LEDs for a soft festive glow.

Eight lighting sequences including steady on, slow fade and twinkle.

Built-in timer and memory function for daily operation and recall of your last selected setting.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor displays, including living rooms, entrances, patios and gardens.

Mains powered with an approximately 5m lead.

Lighting sequences

Combination, In Waves, Sequential, Slow Glow, Chasing/Flash, Slow Fade, Twinkle/Flash and Steady On.

Product specifications

This decorative twig tree measures approximately 1.8m (180cm) in height. It has brown branches with a snowy finish, 300 warm white LEDs and a square base. It is mains powered and suitable for indoor and outdoor use.

What’s included

One 6ft Snowy LED Twig Tree with 300 warm white LEDs, supplied in the original manufacturer’s packaging with the manufacturer’s electrical accessories.
Package contents: Includes one 6ft (approx. 1.8m) Snowy Effect Twig Tree with 300 warm white LEDs, a square base and an approximately 5m mains lead. When activated, the built-in timer switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours in a repeating daily cycle.
Setup and seasonal storage: The 6ft Snowy Effect LED Twig Tree comes with a square base for display on a stable, level surface. Follow the manufacturer’s assembly instructions when setting it up, and keep the original packaging for storage between festive seasons.
Snow-effect twig branches: The 6ft LED Twig Tree features slim brown branches with a snow-effect finish for a natural winter look. The open branch design lets the 300 warm white LEDs shine through, creating a soft festive glow
300 warm white LED lights: The 6ft Snowy Effect Twig Tree features 300 warm white LEDs along its snow-effect branches, creating a soft festive glow. Choose from eight lighting sequences, including a steady glow and a twinkling effect, to suit your
Festive lighting for indoor and outdoor displays: With snow-effect branches and 300 warm white LEDs, this 6ft twig tree adds a welcoming glow to living rooms, entrances, patios and gardens. Display it for Christmas, winter gatherings or seasonal events.
Guarantee - 1 month

Hinged branches fold down for assembly, ready for you to gently arrange and shape. The included folding metal stand provides a practical base and packs away neatly when the festivities are over.

Features: 
 Mixed foliage for a realistic, full appearance
 Hinged branch construction
 Folding metal stand included
 Unlit, ready for your own choice of lights
 Suitable for indoor use only

For the best finish, gently spread the branches and arrange the individual tips to bring out the tree's full shape before decorating.

Lights and decorations not included

7906816232891.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Assembly Required: Featuring a wrapped design, this mini Christmas tree is easy to set up. Simply remove it from the box and fluff the branches to achieve a fuller appearance, with no complicated assembly needed.
Durable PVC Material: Made from PVC, the tree features realistic, full-looking foliage and flexible branches that can hold lightweight Christmas lights and decorations. Designed for repeated seasonal use.
Compact Tabletop Design: Standing at 24 inches, this mini artificial Christmas tree is ideal for tables, desks, shelves and other small spaces. Its lightweight design makes it easy to move, display and store.
Snow-Flocked Festive Appearance: The classic green foliage with a snow-flocked finish creates a charming winter look. Add your favourite ornaments to personalise your Christmas decorations.
Stable Cement Base: The sturdy cement base provides reliable support to help keep the tree upright. Wrapped in decorative linen fabric, it also adds a neat finishing touch to the overall design.
 
Specifications
Colour: White
Material: New, PVC, Metal, Plastic
Height: 4 ft/ 180 cm
Base Dimensions: 21 cm x 21 cm
Number of Lights: 48
Net Weight: 1 kg
Rated Input Voltage: 120v/ 60hz
Rated Output Voltage: 12v
Cord Length: 6 ft
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.
Easy to Fluff and No Assemble Required: All wrapped construction makes the Christmas tree easy to fluff and can help you save a lot of time and energy. Of course, the Christmas tree has no complicated assembly steps. All you need to do is taking it out of the box and adjusting the pine needle shape.
High-Quality New PVC Material: The Christmas tree is made of 100% new PVC material, which is durable and long-lasting, so it can be recycled for a long time. PVC material not only makes the tree looks lush and real, but also adds the anti-crush capacity to the tree, and it can hold many lights and decorations.
Perfect Mini Artificial Tree: This charming Christmas tree is only 24 inches without taking up too much space, and easy for clean and storage. The mini size design is lightweight and easy to move and carry, making it an ideal decoration for your room, table, office desk and any other small space.
A Great Decoration for Christmas: The snow flocked Christmas tree in classic green color design to help emulate a real Christmas tree. And this tabletop artificial tree is definitely your ideal Christmas decoration for your home. It is full of festive atmosphere, you can use more decorations to ornament it, making it light up your Christmas!
Stable Cement Stand: We use cement scaffolds instead of cheap plastic or metal scaffolds and cover them with linen cloth, creating a more stable base sit on the table. What we want to achieve is to increase the stability of the tree and prevent it from tipping over, and the linen cloth cover is to protect your floor and has a good decorative effect.
Guarantee - 1 year
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required
With stand

Product Introduction
Add timeless rustic luxury to your holiday setup with our burgundy velvet decorative bows. Each pre-formed bow features soft, thick velvet with rich wine red colour, paired with golden twist ties for simple installation. No tedious tying required. The
 elegant silhouette delivers a high-end vintage Christmas atmosphere, great for creating a warm, sophisticated festive look.
Product Specifications

 Pack: 24 velvet bows
 Fabric: Premium plush velvet
 Dimension: 3.5 inches (9cm)
 Fastener: Gold twist tie
 Colour: Deep burgundy
 Characteristic: Pre-tied, maintain shape, reusable

Application Scenarios
Perfect adornment for flocked Christmas trees, front door wreaths, fireplace garlands, holiday gift boxes and kraft gift bags. Suitable for Christmas parties, winter bridal showers, farmhouse style home decor and seasonal craft projects.
Notes

 Velvet material is not washable; wipe stains gently with dry cloth.
 Avoid long-time exposure under direct strong sunlight to prevent colour fading.
 Twist ties are for fixing only, do not bear heavy weight.
 Keep away from open flame
Rich Burgundy Velvet: Made from soft, plush velvet fabric with a smooth, even sheen, these deep wine-red bows bring a warm, elegant vintage tone to your holiday décor — a classic alternative to bright red for a more sophisticated festive look.
Perfect Mini Size: Each bow measures approximately 3.5" x 3.5", a delicate size ideal for mini/tabletop Christmas trees, filling in gaps on a full-size tree, or topping small gift boxes without overwhelming the space.
Twist Tie for Easy Attachment: Each bow comes with a gold twist tie on the back, making it simple to fasten onto tree branches, wreaths, garlands, or stair railings — no glue, no hooks, just twist and secure.
Versatile Holiday Decorating: Beyond the Christmas tree, use these bows to dress up wreaths, garlands, staircases, wine bottles, or gift wrapping. Also great for sealing treat bags and bakery boxes for a festive finishing touch.
Festive Elegance for Every Occasion: Whether for Christmas, New Year, winter weddings, or holiday parties, these burgundy velvet bows add a refined, vintage-inspired charm to any decoration or gift. (Note: actual color may vary slightly due to lighting and screen display.)

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Gold. Stated size: 3 cm; 4 cm; 5 cm. Quantity: 42 pack.
Pack of 42 festive gold baubles with a sparkling glitter finish for your Christmas tree.
Available in three assorted sizes: 3 cm, 4 cm, and 5 cm to create visual depth.
Durable plastic construction ensures longevity and easy handling during decoration.
Versatile hanging design allows for flexible placement on branches or displays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 42 Christmas baubles

Product Description

 This Christmas banner set contains two vertical hanging banners. One banner displays “MERRY” and the other displays “CHRISTMAS”, decorated with snowflakes, reindeer and Santa sleigh patterns.

Red Berry Accents

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

4313817010091.variantName: Set of 3 Light Up Gift Boxes, Battery Powered Holiday Present Box Decor, Versatile Ornament for Christmas, Valentine's Day Parties
4313817010091.sourceDescription:
Premium Durable Construction
These pre-lit Christmas gift boxes feature a robust PVC frame paired with finely hand-sewn tinsel fabric. Exquisitely embellished with realistic pine cones and pine needles, they deliver delicate sparkling details, effortlessly upgrading your festive
 decor with authentic Christmas charm.
Warm Enchanting LED Lighting
This set of three decorative gift boxes is fitted with 50 warm white LED lights in total, casting a soft, cosy and magical ambient glow. Ideal for placement under Christmas trees, these illuminated boxes add a wonderful festive atmosphere and a touch
 of magic to your Christmas celebrations.
8 Lighting Modes & Battery Operated Design
The three boxes are equipped with graded LED quantities: 20 LEDs for the large box, 18 LEDs for the medium box and 12 LEDs for the small box. It supports 8 adjustable lighting modes including steady-on, flashing and slow fading to suit diverse festive
 styles. Each box is powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries not included). The cordless battery design enables safe indoor and outdoor use with no need for mains power sockets.
3 Practical Sizes & Space-Saving Storage
This decorative set includes three gift boxes in assorted sizes: 15.5 cm (6 inches), 20.5 cm (8 inches) and 25.5 cm (10 inches). The matched sizing allows easy stacking display and convenient space-saving storage after the holiday season.
Versatile Festive Decoration
Perfect for Christmas and winter festive styling, these pre-lit gift boxes fit a wide range of scenarios. Suitable for indoor ornamentation, holiday party layouts and outdoor yard displays, they blend seamlessly with all Christmas themes and fill your
 home with festive joy throughout the season.
Pack of 3 Light‑Up Christmas Gift Boxes - Decorative illuminated present‑shaped boxes, embellished with snowflake details and elegant bowknot decorations.
Battery‑Operated LED Lighting - Battery powered without messy cables, creates warm glowing effect for cosy festive atmosphere indoors.
Indoor & Covered‑Outdoor Usage - Perfect for porches, yards, under Christmas trees, mantels and party display layouts.
Multi‑Holiday Decorative Ornament - Not only for Christmas, also works for Valentine’s Day and other holiday party scene styling.
Ready‑to‑use Seasonal Decor - Pre‑assembled design, no complex installation. Reusable for repeated holiday seasons.
Indoor Use

5037204458691.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Natural wood material adds a warm, traditional touch to displays.

Easy to arrange and reposition for flexible seasonal decorating.

5096042276591.baseName: Christmas bauble wreath - Hanging Christmas decoration - Metallic baubles and gold ribbon for festive doors and walls - 33 cm
5096042276591.variantName: Christmas bauble wreath - Hanging Christmas decoration - Metallic baubles and gold ribbon for festive doors and walls - 33 cm
5096042276591.sourceDescription:
Bronze, copper, brown and gold baubles form a warm metallic ring. The reverse is finished in gold glitter foam and can lie flat on a table. Use the supplied gold ribbon when you want to hang it. At 33 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

Baubles carry the colour across the whole shape, with curves and small gaps creating changes in the way the light falls. That varied surface gives a single wreath much of the visual interest of a group of individual ornaments. Curved bauble surfaces reflect the colours immediately around them. Try hanging the wreath where it catches a little daylight and leave space in front of the decorations to show the different surfaces.

If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges. Keep heavy ornaments and tightly coiled strings of lights separate so that the front of the wreath keeps its shape in storage.

A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.
Metallic baubles in gold, bronze, brown and copper create a warm festive ring.
Gold glitter foam backing allows the wreath to lie flat on a table or be hung with ribbon.
Compact 33 cm diameter size is ideal for doors, walls or small spaces without overwhelming decor.
Varied curved surfaces reflect light beautifully, adding visual interest as a standalone piece.
Comes with Gold ribbon for hanging
Hanging rope included

5058194849191.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red. Stated size: 35cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Lightweight design for easy handling and convenient storage.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif for festive appeal.
Compact 35cm size fits well in smaller spaces or displays.
Durable plastic construction in a vibrant red colour.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Add traditional Christmas charm to your home with this Light Up Teardrop Door Wreath. The elongated decoration measures approximately 72cm high and 38cm wide, making it a noticeable festive feature for suitable doors, hallways, walls and indoor entrance displays. Layered green pine-style foliage provides a rich background for red, burgundy and gold baubles, while a neutral bow adds a coordinated decorative finish. A glitter-style Merry Christmas sign sits prominently within the arrangement, bringing a welcoming seasonal message to the design. Warm white LEDs are distributed through the foliage to create soft illumination during evening celebrations and cosy winter nights. The convenient hanging loop makes installation straightforward on suitable supports, allowing the wreath to be displayed without occupying floor space. Its battery-operated lighting system requires three AA batteries, removing the need for a nearby mains socket or trailing electrical lead. Batteries are not supplied. ELONGATED TEARDROP SHAPE: Distinctive hanging form provides a decorative alternative to traditional round wreaths, with a convenient loop for positioning on suitable indoor doors, walls and windows without taking up floor space.
BATTERY POWERED 72 X 38CM DECORATION: Approximately 72cm tall and 38cm wide, providing generous festive coverage while the LEDs operate from three AA batteries for convenient cable-free positioning. Batteries are not included.
